name: Take page Back button returns to the previous question
description: After answering a question and advancing, clicking the Back button returns to the previous question. Replaces the keyboard-shortcut test, which the checker cannot drive reliably (window-level keydown synthesis).

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice take page
Click the numbered answer option 4 for the first question to answer it
Verify the progress indicator advances to '2 of 36' and a second question is shown.
Click the 'Back' button in the navigation row above the question
Verify the progress indicator returns to '1 of 36' and the first question is shown again, confirming backward navigation works.
